name: Leon Kuze
source:
A surface pilot who was in Yuuya’s unit in their US army days. Yuuya’s kill score left his in the dust. Presently part of the 65th Combat Training Battalion “Infinities”. He’s proud to be a Japanese-American, which meant he's constantly at odds with Yuuya. The two of them used to fight constantly.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
